accessibility.title: LZ76 factorization of ABRACADABRA!
accessibility.description: Each row shows the text available before the factor begins, the longest matching prefix, the following symbol, and the resulting factor. Positions are one-based. Empty history is shown as ∅ and an empty match as a dash. Blue marks the chosen earlier match; teal marks every following symbol, including A, B and R in the first three factors.
accessibility.social_description: ABRACADABRA! has six factors: A, B, R, AC, AD, ABRA!. Every factor ends with a teal symbol. At position eight, earlier text ABRACAD contains the blue matching prefix ABRA; appending the next symbol ! gives ABRA!. Entropy, Effective measure complexity and information distance for Python, Rust and the command line.
